yangfanyu:study:1.title: The earliest euantiarch from the Pragian (Early Devonian) of Guangnan, Yunnan Province, China (The Science of Nature, 2026)

facts.statement: Yangfanyu is a newly described genus and species of early euantiarch fish.
facts.quote:
Name: Yangfanyu
Novelty: Gen. et sp. nov

facts.statement: The genus Yangfanyu was described by Xian and colleagues.
Yangfanyu lived during the Pragian stage of the Early Devonian period.
Fossils of Yangfanyu were found in China.
Yangfanyu is an early member of the clade Euantiarcha.
facts.quote: Notes: An early member of Euantiarcha.

facts.statement: The genus Yangfanyu includes the species Y. anachoresis.
facts.quote: Genus includes new species Y. anachoresis.

facts.statement: The study describing Yangfanyu was published in The Science of Nature in 2026.
facts.quote:
Journal: The Science of Nature
Year: 2026

facts.statement: The authors of the Yangfanyu study are Zumin Xian, Qinyuan Xue, Yingtian Zhao, Qiang Li, and Min Zhu.
facts.quote: Authors: Zumin Xian, Qinyuan Xue, Yingtian Zhao, Qiang Li, Min Zhu
